report.summary: The journey stopped early with 2 browser actions with recorded outcomes. Journey completion was not confirmed, and no observed journey failure was established. Automated checks produced 15 findings; review their evidence and coverage separately.

findings.fix: Reduce render-blocking work and optimize the largest above-the-fold element.
findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint is slow
findings.detail: A single browser visit observed LCP at 5356 ms; the good threshold is 2500 ms. This is not a Lighthouse lab run or population field p75. No resource attribution was captured.

findings.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds and dynamic content before they load.
findings.title: Layout shifts exceed the Core Web Vitals target
findings.detail: A single browser visit observed CLS at 0.126; the good threshold is 0.1 . This is not a Lighthouse lab run or population field p75. No resource attribution was captured.

findings.fix: Describe each meaningful image in its alt attribute; use alt="" for decorative ones.
findings.title: Images have no alt text
findings.detail: 1 of 1 images on https://www.scribb.xyz/about/ have no alt text. Images without alt text are invisible to search engines and screen readers.

findings.fix: Add script-src 'self' (plus the hosts you load scripts from), or default-src 'self'.
findings.title: CSP does not restrict scripts
findings.detail: The policy has neither script-src nor default-src, so an injected script runs as if there were no CSP. Found on 9 of 9 audited pages.

findings.fix: Add one TXT record to the domain listing your email provider, for example v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all (use your provider's value).
findings.title: No SPF record
findings.detail: scribb.xyz does not say which servers may send its email, so signup, verification and password-reset emails are more likely to land in spam or be rejected.

findings.fix: Put the most important words first. Shortening is optional.
findings.title: Page title is too long
findings.detail: The title is 67 characters. Advisory: there is no length limit, but long titles are shortened in search results to fit the screen.
findings.evidence: ravidayama596 (@ravidayama596) · Sketchbooks and journals on Scribb

findings.fix: Say what the page offers and why to visit. There is no required length.
findings.title: Meta description is too short
findings.detail: 49 characters. Advisory: a very short description is often replaced with text from the page.

findings.fix: Add useful content, merge the page into a stronger one, or mark it noindex.
findings.title: Thin content
findings.detail: About 95 words of text before JavaScript runs. Pages this short rarely rank. Found on 2 of 9 audited pages.

findings.fix: Add the missing properties with values that match the visible page, then use Google's Rich Results Test.
findings.title: WebApplication rich-result fields are incomplete
findings.detail: The JSON-LD omits Google's required properties: review or aggregateRating. This may prevent the rich result.

findings.fix: Open with a 25 to 50 word paragraph that says what it is, who it is for and one concrete number.
findings.title: No plain answer near the top
findings.detail: None of the first paragraphs is a full sentence or two about what the page offers. Assistants quote early, self-contained paragraphs.

findings.fix: Publish a plain-text /.well-known/ai.txt describing the site and linking to its key pages.
findings.title: No /.well-known/ai.txt
findings.detail: This optional AI discovery file is absent or serves HTML. Its effect on AI search is not established; fix crawler access and content first.

findings.fix: Publish a plain-text /llms-full.txt describing the site and linking to its key pages.
findings.title: No /llms-full.txt
findings.detail: This optional AI discovery file is absent or serves HTML. Its effect on AI search is not established; fix crawler access and content first.

findings.fix: Start important sections with a 15 to 100 word paragraph that answers the heading.
findings.title: Sections lack an answer near the heading
findings.detail: Long sections do not open with a self-contained answer.

findings.fix: Add a CAA record for the authority you use, for example: 0 issue "letsencrypt.org".
findings.title: No CAA record
findings.detail: scribb.xyz does not name which certificate authorities may issue certificates for it, so a mistake or attack at any authority can produce a valid certificate.

findings.fix: Add MX records for your email provider, or send from an address on a domain that receives mail.
findings.title: Domain has no MX record
findings.detail: scribb.xyz cannot receive email, so replies to your signup and support emails bounce.

tactics.title: Link exchanges
tactics.policy: Excessive or reciprocal and three-way exchanges, automated link creation and links bought to rank are link spam under Google's policy. Paid placements must be marked rel="sponsored".
tactics.reader_benefit: Link only where a page genuinely helps the reader, for its own editorial reason.

separate.backlinks: No link data was read for this report, so nothing here measures links you have or lost.
separate.ai_citations: AI citations are sampled separately with engine, prompt, date, sources and sample size. A brand mention or an answer from memory is not a citation, and a failed or missing sample is not zero visibility.
separate.geo_readiness: GEO readiness (its own chapter) checks whether AI crawlers can read and understand your pages.
